ABOUT MANYU
LITTLEMANYU is about the happy life of a Shiba Inu named MANYU. She hopes to experience every bit of beauty in the world with her loving dad and her adorable brother BAI (a West Highland White Terrier). We aim to share this beauty with everyone, wishing you all health, happiness, and carefree joy!🐾

This is the official YouTube channel of Littlemanyu. Kindly hit SUBSCRIBE and let's follow the adorable moments of Manyu and Bai together!

Discover More and Shop the Products We Love and Recommend for You and Your Furry Friends! Visit our Official Website🐶: www.manyuland.com 

Business Contact: bizmanyu@gmail.com
